whole_case_success: All scientific items marked required_for_whole_case_success must pass, and evidence qualification must pass; arbitrary thresholds such as 60 points are not used. The original rules assess recovery of bounded conclusions from the literature and do not establish a uniquely true mechanism.
numeric_comparison_policy: Retain the existing numerical targets/tolerances. First review comparability of physical identities, references and conditions. If comparability cannot be determined, mark needs_review and explain why; do not unilaterally change tolerances. Source numbers without targets are context only, not implicit thresholds.
semantic_review_policy: A chemistry reviewer blinded to system identity assigns pass/fail/needs_review based on native computational evidence. Equivalent mechanisms supporting the same physical proposition are allowed; keyword matching alone is insufficient.

rules.expected: Actual structures and reaction-connectivity evidence support base-induced removal of the N–H hydrogen of 3-nitropyrrole and formation of H2, preserving the β-nitropyrrole identity and balancing atoms/charges. The authors' hydride-contact model TS1 is a reference; chemically equivalent representations are allowed, and source coordinates or a fixed search method are not mandatory. Merely writing a deprotonation label or providing an unvalidated TS earns no credit.
rules.qualification: Must be supported by actual computational evidence from this run, with compatible species/configurations, composition, charge/spin, conditions, physical quantities and references. Labels, supplied observations and normal termination cannot substitute for this evidence.

rules.expected: Valid calculations support the deprotonated nitrogen-containing pyrrole state and its corresponding stabilization, maintaining a mapping of the same anionic skeleton to the precursor for subsequent propargylation. The authors' S2/H2 contact state at approximately −25.5 kcal/mol relative to the initial state is context; the same contact partner/conformation is not mandatory. An actual intermediate state and connectivity relationships must be obtained; two mutually unbalanced models cannot be spliced together.
rules.qualification: Must be supported by actual computational evidence from this run, with compatible species/configurations, composition, charge/spin, conditions, physical quantities and references. Labels, supplied observations and normal termination cannot substitute for this evidence.

rules.expected: Actual reaction structures, vibrational modes and appropriate connectivity evidence support bond formation between pyrrole N and the propargylic carbon and C–Br cleavage, retaining the terminal alkyne and β-nitro position. The SN2 channel of the authors' TS2 is a reference. Author labels or a full IRC are not mandatory, but merely calculating a nonreactive imaginary frequency or a product with incorrect substitution positions earns no credit.
rules.qualification: Must be supported by actual computational evidence from this run, with compatible species/configurations, composition, charge/spin, conditions, physical quantities and references. Labels, supplied observations and normal termination cannot substitute for this evidence.

rules.expected: Compatible energy definitions and complete material/charge accounting yield a calculated substantially exergonic trend for net formation of the N-propargyl product. The authors' G of approximately −45.5 kcal/mol is reference context, with no hidden exact window. Do not omit H2/reagents/Br or derive ΔG directly from the yield.
rules.qualification: Must be supported by actual computational evidence from this run, with compatible species/configurations, composition, charge/spin, conditions, physical quantities and references. Labels, supplied observations and normal termination cannot substitute for this evidence.

rules.expected: Finally, use a computationally supported connected explanation to link the roles of the substrate, base and alkylating reagent through to the correct N-propargyl product. The authors' deprotonation followed by substitution is a reference; equivalent routes supported by actual evidence are acceptable. Merely showing isolated TSs/products or proposing an untested reaction type is insufficient.
rules.qualification: Must be supported by actual computational evidence from this run, with compatible species/configurations, composition, charge/spin, conditions, physical quantities and references. Labels, supplied observations and normal termination cannot substitute for this evidence.

rules.expected: Using the connected pathway and comparable energies, explicitly establish that subsequent N–C substitution has a more pronounced local activation requirement than the preceding near-reactant deprotonation, while the net conversion is exergonic. Correctly distinguish relative profile heights, local barriers from the respective precursors and the reaction ΔG; the authors' 16.2 is only an energy difference under their reference definition. Do not describe a negative relative TS G as an experimentally strictly barrierless reaction, or infer a quantitative rate from 89%/24h.
rules.qualification: Must be supported by actual computational evidence from this run, with compatible species/configurations, composition, charge/spin, conditions, physical quantities and references. Labels, supplied observations and normal termination cannot substitute for this evidence.

reference_issues: The simplified source TS does not contain Na; effects of the full solid NaH/ion-pair system have not been established. A negative plotted relative TS height does not imply a zero local barrier.
